title: Lagrange interpolation processes based on the zeros of anti-Gauss Jacobi polynomials
summary: This paper introduces and investigates a new Lagrange interpolation process based on the zeros of anti-Gauss Jacobi polynomials. Fundamental properties of anti-Gauss nodes, including their asymptotic distribution, are established, together with estimates for the associated polynomials and their derivatives. These results provide the basis for the construction of an interpolation process whose weighted Lebesgue constants exhibit logarithmic growth, ensuring optimal approximation properties.
